item.name: Shadow Amulet

effects.title: Fade
effects.text: Grants invisibility to you or a target allied hero for 3.5s. Movement speed during the invisibility is reduced by 35%.

notes: Takes 1.25s of the 3.5s for the hero to fully fade into invisibility.
item.lore: A small talisman that clouds the senses of one's enemies when held perfectly still.
